title: SpotDraft Pricing and Plans
markdown:
# Pricing

- **Flexible Pricing:** Plans that fit your business, price based on contract volume. No wasted spend.
- **In-House Implementation, Always Included:** Our team helps set up your workflows & integrations, and migrate legacy contracts, no extra fees, no outsourcing.
- **Always-On Support:** Dedicated customer success and 24/7 support, for every single customer

## Features

[**Contract Creation**![Dropdown arrow icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/667c30b5ca93ab782c641f30_Dropdown%20arrow.svg)\\
\\
Contract templates in SpotDraft help your teams create customized contracts, self-serve and in minutes. You can get them to the right people for approvals automatically – while minimizing legal risk and review times.\\
\\
Get Pricing\\
\\
![SpotDraft Contract Creation feature illustration](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/69452337092b9fdd3f36847d_Contract%20Creation.avif)](https://www.spotdraft.com/pricing#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-0) [**eSignatures**![Dropdown arrow icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/667c30b5ca93ab782c641f30_Dropdown%20arrow.svg)\\
\\
SpotDraft’s native digital signature solution is a faster, more secure, and efficient way to collect signatures for legal documents. SpotDraft meets global compliance standards such as ESIGN, eIDAS and ECA.\\
\\
Get Pricing\\
\\
![SpotDraft eSignature feature illustration](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/6945233770ceec3c856747dc_ESIGN.avif)](https://www.spotdraft.com/pricing#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-1) [**Automated Workflows**![Dropdown arrow icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/667c30b5ca93ab782c641f30_Dropdown%20arrow.svg)\\
\\
Create your own workflows to automate key legal processes like contract creation, reviews, and approvals – no technical expertise required.\\
\\
Get Pricing\\
\\
![SpotDraft automated workflows feature illustration](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/69452337e737595235f87f77_Automated%20workflows.avif)](https://www.spotdraft.com/pricing#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-2) [**Management and Repository**![Dropdown arrow icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/667c30b5ca93ab782c641f30_Dropdown%20arrow.svg)\\
\\
SpotDraft Repository centralizes all of your contracts and automatically pulls over 1000 types of contract metadata using AI so you can access, organize, and search your contracts easily.\\
\\
Get Pricing\\
\\
![SpotDraft Management and Repository feature illustration](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/694523373ab594a562f4566b_Management%20and%20Repository.avif)](https://www.spotdraft.com/pricing#w-tabs-0-data-w-pane-3) [**Implementation and Support**![Dropdown arrow icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5f2c07287a7a7437ea684517/667c30b5ca93ab782c641f30_Dropdown%20arrow.svg)\\
\\
Get complete, end-to-end implementation done for you. In-house experts set up all your contract templates workflow automations, and integrations. We’ll also migrate your contract data into SpotDraft for you. Every customer gets a dedicated Account Manager, and 24/7 support.\\
\\
Get Pricing\\
\\
